meaning: “New” means that, to our knowledge, the specific construction has not been explicitly described in the literature. We do not claim that the resulting category is new up to tensor equivalence or exotic.
coverage: The project’s currently documented construction shortlist. Entries are examples attached to realized census rings, not a count of inequivalent tensor categories or an exhaustive survey of the literature.

entries.title: Sign-swap equivariantization
entries.construction: Condense the diagonal central boson in the product of two identical half-E₆ categories, then equivariantize the factor-swap action with a sign on the condensed algebra.
entries.inputs: The half-E₆ category; condensation of the diagonal central boson and equivariantization.

entries.title: Mixed diagonal-fermion quotient
entries.construction: Take the category of modules over the diagonal central boson in the product of half-E₆ and PSU(2)₆.
entries.inputs: The known half-E₆ and PSU(2)₆ categories and their central fermions.

entries.title: Relative Fibonacci center of TT₃
entries.construction: Form the relative center Z_Fib(TT₃), using the Fibonacci subcategory of the dual even part of the 2D2 subfactor.
entries.inputs: The known category TT₃ and the standard relative-center construction.

entries.title: Inversion descent from NG(C₄ × C₄, 16)
entries.construction: Construct a near-group orbifold, descend a coherent inversion action, and take the Morita dual associated to the reflection algebra. The resulting invertible group is C₂ × C₂.
entries.inputs: The Yu–Zhang near-group category NG(C₄ × C₄, 16) and near-group orbifold machinery.

entries.title: Inversion descent from NG(C₁₆, 16)
entries.construction: Apply the orbifold, inversion-descent and reflection-algebra Morita construction to the cyclic near-group input. Here the invertible group is C₄, and the two large noninvertible simples are mutually dual.
entries.inputs: Budinski’s NG(C₁₆, 16) category and Izumi’s near-group orbifold machinery.

entries.title: Nonsplit C₂-extension of 2D2
entries.construction: Transport an odd automorphism through a crossed product to obtain an extension in which the odd invertible a satisfies a² = g, with g the nontrivial invertible in the neutral 2D2 category.
entries.inputs: The known unitary 2D2 category and the Grossman–Izumi–Snyder construction framework.

entries.title: Davydov–Runkel extension of a 16-dimensional Hopf algebra
entries.construction: Use an explicit Davydov–Runkel extension of Kashina’s self-dual 16-dimensional Hopf algebra. The resulting simple dimensions are 1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 4.
entries.inputs: Kashina’s Hopf algebra and the general Davydov–Runkel extension construction.

entries.title: Phase-rotation equivariantization of NG(C₃, 6)
entries.construction: Equivariantize the coherent order-two phase-rotation action on Izumi’s unitary near-group category. Its sign on the unit-output channels distinguishes this construction from the reflection variant.
entries.inputs: Izumi’s NG(C₃, 6) solution and its explicit tensor automorphisms.

entries.title: Reflection equivariantization of NG(C₃, 6)
entries.construction: Equivariantize the coherent order-two reflection action on the same near-group category. The reflection and phase-rotation actions yield different complete fusion tensors.
entries.inputs: Izumi’s NG(C₃, 6) solution and its explicit tensor automorphisms.

entries.title: Cyclic permutation of three Fibonacci factors
entries.construction: Equivariantize Fib ⊠ Fib ⊠ Fib by the canonical C₃ action that cyclically permutes its factors. Character averaging on the fusion spaces determines the complete tensor.
entries.inputs: The Fibonacci category and the standard permutation action on a tensor power.

entries.title: Morita dual of the nonsplit 2D2 extension
entries.construction: Take bimodules over the inherited Q-system 1 + r in the nonsplit C₂-extension represented by R8_2_37. The neutral component is TT₃; the odd component and its products determine this rank-eight ring.
entries.inputs: The nonsplit extension above, the known Q-system 1 + r, and the category TT₃.

entries.title: A twisted alternating-group construction
entries.construction: Construct C(A₆, ω, A₅, ψ) from a specified relative μ₂-cocycle class. Stable-element and projective-stabilizer calculations determine the twisting and the full fusion tensor.
entries.inputs: The alternating groups A₆ and A₅, the stable-elements theorem, and the standard group-theoretical category construction.

entries.title: Cyclic generalized TY orbifold · identity coherence
entries.construction: An explicit central C₃ condensation produces a generalized Tambara–Yamagami category with invertible group C₉. Equivariantize its inversion action with the identity square coherence.
entries.inputs: TY(C₃), a specified pointed C₉ category, and central condensation. R9_2_1209 is the other parity-coherence variant.
entries.selection: Explicit new construction in the fourth rank-nine continuation

entries.title: Cyclic generalized TY orbifold · parity coherence
entries.construction: Use the same central C₃ condensation and coherent inversion action, with the negative square coherence on the odd component. This yields the second cyclic generalized Tambara–Yamagami orbifold.
entries.inputs: The same TY(C₃) and pointed C₉ inputs as R9_2_746; the parity natural automorphism changes the coherence.
entries.selection: Explicit new construction in the fourth rank-nine continuation

entries.title: Order-four descent to a Moore–Read equivariantization
entries.construction: A mixed order-four tensor functor on a covering category descends, after central boson condensation, to a coherent C₂ action on a generalized Moore–Read category. Equivariantization gives the recorded rank-nine model.
entries.inputs: An Ising category, a specified pointed C₁₆ category, and the generalized Moore–Read construction.
entries.selection: Explicit new action in the fourth rank-nine continuation

entries.title: Dihedral pullback of the LPR-24 action · C₉
entries.construction: Recover a coherent S₃ action from the known LPR-24 category by Tannakian descent, pull it back along Dih(C₉) → S₃, and equivariantize.
entries.inputs: The known LPR-24 category and coherent equivariantization. The project derives the central-lift argument and this specific pullback model.
entries.selection: The proof explicitly distinguishes these project deductions from the cited literature

entries.title: Dihedral pullback of the LPR-24 action · C₃ × C₃
entries.construction: Pull back the same coherent S₃ action along Dih(C₃ × C₃) → S₃ and equivariantize. The different covering group gives a second rank-nine fusion tensor.
entries.inputs: The known LPR-24 category and the same Tannakian descent as R9_2_1396, with an elementary-abelian covering group.
entries.selection: The proof explicitly distinguishes these project deductions from the cited literature
